name: Cu Chi
provinceNote: From 1 July 2025 the old huyện Củ Chi is seven communes. The new xã Củ Chi is only Tân Phú Trung, Tân Thông Hội, and Phước Vĩnh An. It is not the tunnel gate. Bến Dược is in xã An Nhơn Tây. Bến Đình is in xã Nhuận Đức.
dotReason: Worth it if you are already nearby
summary: You come for a dark mouth in the earth, the tunnel entrance under the trees. Sleep in Ho Chi Minh City and give the relic a day, or take the operator’s homestay on the Sài Gòn river at Bến Dược if that night is the booking. Bến Đình, on Provincial Road 15, is the other conserved site. Do not use one ticket or one address for both.
fee: No single ticket for both gates
getThere: About 1 hour to Bến Dược, and about 70 km for the tunnels
seoTitle: Cu Chi tunnels — two gates, a day from the city centre
seoDescription: About one hour to Bến Dược, or about 70 km for the tunnels, gates not split. The ordinary gate is 7:00–17:00. Bến Đình is separate, on Provincial Road 15.
intro: The frame is the ground: a dark mouth in the earth, leaves around the lip, the tree behind it. You come for the conserved tunnels northwest of Ho Chi Minh City. Most visits sleep in the city and return the same day. The night on the relic, when the booking is here, is the operator’s homestay and tents on the Sài Gòn river at Bến Dược. No hotel brand.

Bến Dược and Bến Đình stay two sites. Bến Dược is the regional command ground at ấp Phú Hiệp. The operator’s Vietnamese site prints xã Ân Nhơn Tây. The footer and the 19 Jan 2026 ticket notice print xã An Nhơn Tây. The English site still prints Phu Hiep Hamlet, Phu My Hung Commune, Cu Chi District. From 1 July 2025 the old xã Phú Mỹ Hưng sits inside xã An Nhơn Tây. Bến Đình is the old district-committee base at ấp Bến Đình, xã Nhuận Đức, on Provincial Road 15. The operator’s site still says huyện Củ Chi. Do not send a driver to the new xã Củ Chi. Do not use 87A Trần Kế Xương in Phú Nhuận. The operator lists that as a 1955–1958 liaison office, not this ground.

The ordinary gate is 7:00–17:00, including Saturday, Sunday, and Tết on the operator’s 2021 notice and on the 2025 homestay note. The Ho Chi Minh City Tourism Promotion Center and Trung tâm Báo chí Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, on 23 Apr 2024, print the same hours every day. After 17:00 the grounds are quiet unless the night is Trăng chiến khu. The 2026 notices put the show at 18:00–20:30 or 18:00–20:40, both end times, at 399,000 đồng a person. That ticket is not the daytime gate. The desk is at ấp Phú Hiệp. The 2026 notices do not put the show at Bến Đình. The next night is Check on arrival.

Do not collapse the gates into one price or one kilometre. From 1 Feb 2026 the operator’s foreign notice prints historical-site admission at 35,000 đồng and a service-and-guide ticket at 100,000 đồng. It does not print a combined total, and it does not print a Vietnamese ticket. The service ticket had been 90,000 đồng. The tourism center and the 23 Apr 2024 press article both print 70,000 đồng for an international visitor and 35,000 đồng for a Vietnamese adult. The tourism center prints no effective date on the 70,000 đồng. A price that belongs only to Bến Đình was not printed. Check on arrival. Cục Di sản văn hóa says the tunnels are longer than 200 km, with about 500 km of surface trenches. The press article says about nearly 250 km. The tourism center says the system spreads over more than 250 km². Keep the length, the shorter length, and the area as three different figures.
gettingAround: The operator’s homestay note of 31 May 2025 says Bến Dược is about one hour by road from the city centre, and it prints no kilometre. Trung tâm Báo chí Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, on 23 Apr 2024, says about 70 km and does not split the gates or print a minute. The Ho Chi Minh City Tourism Promotion Center says approximately 70 km northwest, in a sentence that also puts Provincial Road 15 and Phú Hiệp together, and prints no minute. Bến Đình’s own kilometres were not printed. Check on arrival. A minute between the two gates was not printed. Check on arrival.

The operator’s road note of 4 Jul 2014 sends bus 13 from Bến Thành, or 94 from Chợ Lớn, to bến xe Củ Chi, then 79. That note names route 79 “Củ Chi – Dầu Tiếng”. The tourism center prints bus 13 or 94, then 79 to Bến Dược, and does not use the Dầu Tiếng name. Both descriptions stay. For Bến Đình, the 2014 note and the tourism center agree: 13 or 94 to An Sương, 122 to Tân Quy, then 70. A fare and a minute for those buses were not printed. Check on arrival. Do not treat the 2014 note as a clock.

Self-drive on the 2014 note is Trường Chinh, ngã tư An Sương, Hóc Môn, then Provincial Road 15, to “địa đạo Củ Chi”. The operator’s site is the note that puts Provincial Road 15 on Bến Đình. Minutes for that drive were not printed. Check on arrival. The tourism center prints a taxi at 600,000–700,000 đồng a trip and does not say which gate. No second fare was printed. A canoe on the Sài Gòn from bến Bạch Đằng, including Greenlines, is named on the 2014 note. The note says the cost is high and prints no number. Check on arrival. Minutes from Tân Sơn Nhất and from Ga Sài Gòn were not printed. Check on arrival. Ga Sài Gòn is the end of the national line and sits in the city, not in Củ Chi. A future metro section, Tham Lương–Củ Chi, is described as preparation, with completion written as 2035. It is not a station you can board.

Inside Bến Dược, an overnight booking includes a bicycle around the East Sea lake. The operator also names shooting, boats, paintball, and other bicycles, and prints no price. The tourism center names AK-47 and AR-15 at the range and says those activities need a separate ticket, with no price. Check on arrival. The homestay rate is described as ordinary and no number is printed. Check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stayAreas.summary: Return to Ho Chi Minh City the same day. The ordinary gate closes at 17:00.

eat: Rice paper is the craft at xã Phú Hòa Đông. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam puts the lanes about more than 40 km from the city centre. Tạp chí Công Thương puts them about 40 km. Both stay. The sheets are dried in the sun. A serving was not printed. Check on arrival.

The Ho Chi Minh City Tourism Promotion Center also names boiled tapioca with sesame salt at the Hoàng Cầm kitchen, Cu Chi veal, pork-knuckle noodle soup, and durian sugarcane juice along National Highway 22. Tuổi Trẻ, on 5 May 2024, dips the tunnel cassava in salt and does not say sesame. The same center names rambutan, mangosteen, durian, and jackfruit at Trung An. Báo Quốc tế and Người Lao Động describe veal rolled in rice paper, young jackfruit salad, and bamboo-shoot salad. Tuổi Trẻ names more plates at chợ Củ Chi and chợ Việt Kiều. No stall price was printed. Check on arrival.

interestCards.title: The two tunnel grounds
interestCards.summary: Bến Dược and Bến Đình are separate gates. The crawl does not name which one.

interestsBody: The two tunnel grounds are the reason to come. Bến Dược holds the memorial, the night program, and the river homestay. Bến Đình is the other gate, on Provincial Road 15.

interestGroups.title: The two tunnel grounds
interestGroups.summary: For a day on the relic, when the tunnels are the reason you came.
body: Bến Dược is where the regional leadership worked. Cục Di sản văn hóa splits that ground into Khu A, the military command, and Khu B, the party committee. On the same ground you can enter Đền Tưởng niệm Liệt sĩ Bến Dược, the liberated-zone reconstruction, the East Sea lake with three miniature monuments, and a live-fire range. Bến Đình is the district-committee base: hidden lids, a round tunnel mouth, termite-mound vents, an M41 tank, and a reconstructed craft yard for rice paper, rice alcohol, and rice pounding. The whole Cu Chi relic is a special national relic by Quyết định 2367/QĐ-TTg of 23 Dec 2015. Bến Dược alone was a national historic site by Quyết định 54/VHQĐ of 29 Apr 1979. Bến Đình was recognized by Quyết định 101/2004/QĐ-BVHTT of 15 Dec 2004.

The memorial’s area on the heritage inventory is 40,299.3 m², started 19 May 1993, with stage 1 opened 19 Dec 1995. The tourism center does not print that area. For the liberated zone, the tourism center prints 38.5 hectares and three periods, 1961–1964, 1965–1968, and 1969–1972. The heritage inventory prints 197,633.5 m² for a larger cluster: the reconstruction, the East Sea mockup, and the Cedar Falls sand-table house, started 24 May 2008 and opened 19 Dec 2009. Those are not the same boundary. The tourism center says a widened visitor section of about 120 meters on two levels. Do not use 120 meters as the length of the wartime network. Which gate that section belongs to is not printed.

Depths disagree. The 23 Apr 2024 press article says 3 m, 6 m, and 12 m. The tourism center says 3 m, 6 m, and deeper than 12 m. The heritage inventory says some stretches have two or three levels and does not print those metres. Formation disagrees too. The heritage inventory says about 1948, earliest at Tân Phú Trung and Phước Vĩnh An. The tourism center says 1946–1948, then a rapid build from 1961 to 1965. Minutes on the walk were not printed. Check on arrival.

blocks.heading: The memorial at Bến Dược
paragraphs: Đền Tưởng niệm Liệt sĩ Bến Dược is on the Bến Dược ground. The heritage inventory dates the start to 19 May 1993 and stage 1 to 19 Dec 1995, and gives the temple 40,299.3 m², with a basement of nine display sections under the title of Sài Gòn – Gia Định. The operator’s 2021 notice names incense at the memorial and prints no price.

blocks.heading: After 17:00
paragraphs: On an ordinary day the gate closes at 17:00. Arriving at 19:00 and expecting the grounds to be open wastes the evening. On a Trăng chiến khu night the operator describes a moonlit village path, a staged night of tunnel digging, and a performance. People who do not want the late return are pointed at the homestay, nhà nghỉ, and tents. A drink price was not printed. Check on arrival. A bar street was not named.

blocks.heading: Morning on the river
paragraphs: If you slept at the homestay, the operator’s morning is birds in the trees, wind off the river, a coffee on the grounds, a bicycle around the East Sea lake, and a walk in the planted forest. Breakfast for an overnight booking is at the restaurant on the grounds. The dish is not named. The pool is free with that booking. A cafe street in the old town was not named. A town breakfast was not named.

cards.title: Tunnel entrance
cards.summary: A lid in the leaves, and a dark mouth in the earth. Ask which gate you are booked into.

faqs.a: Name the gate. Bến Dược is ấp Phú Hiệp, now xã An Nhơn Tây, and it is the ground with the memorial, the night show, and the river homestay. Bến Đình is ấp Bến Đình, xã Nhuận Đức, on Provincial Road 15. The new xã Củ Chi is Tân Phú Trung, Tân Thông Hội, and Phước Vĩnh An. It is not either gate.

faqs.q: How far is Cu Chi from the city centre?
faqs.a: The operator’s homestay note says about one hour by road to Bến Dược, with no kilometre. The 23 Apr 2024 press article says about 70 km and does not split the gates. The tourism center says approximately 70 km northwest and also merges Provincial Road 15 with Phú Hiệp. Bến Đình’s own kilometres were not printed. Check on arrival.

faqs.q: What does a daytime ticket cost?
faqs.a: From 1 Feb 2026 the operator prints 35,000 đồng for historical-site admission and 100,000 đồng for the service-and-guide ticket, for a foreign visitor. Do not add those into one total. The service ticket had been 90,000 đồng. The tourism center and the 23 Apr 2024 press article print 70,000 đồng international and 35,000 đồng for a Vietnamese adult. The tourism center also prints half price for students and children 7–16, and free entry under 7, for people with disabilities, for the armed forces, and for revolution contributors. A 2005 decision set 15,000 đồng an adult and 7,000 đồng a child from 1 Jan 2006. That is its own date, not the 2026 notice. The tourism center prints 65,000 đồng for the liberated zone. The operator notice does not. A Bến Đình-only price is Check on arrival. Shooting, boats, and paintball have no printed price. Check on arrival.

The operator offers a homestay and tents on the Sài Gòn river at Bến Dược. The rate is described as ordinary and no number is printed. Check on arrival. Breakfast for an overnight booking is included. The dish is not named. Otherwise return to Ho Chi Minh City after 17:00.

The operator prints single nights, not a fixed weekday. The 2026 notices name 1 Jan, 18:00–20:40; 7 Mar, 18:00–20:30; 4 Apr, 18:00–20:40; and a notice titled August 2026 whose body says September 2026 and the date 24 Aug 2026, 18:00–20:40. The ticket on each of those notices is 399,000 đồng. The next night is Check on arrival.

season.label: Quiet after 17:00
season.note: The ordinary gate is 7:00–17:00, including Saturday, Sunday, and Tết. Come in the morning. On a Trăng chiến khu night the show starts at 18:00 and ends at 20:30 or 20:40. Both end times are printed. That night is a separate ticket.
